text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—On this day, I came to inspect the 
racetrack for the sake of <chrname>, but...

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Oguri-san, I heard the news! An event 
will be held to commemorate the production 
and release of your plushie!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...T-Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
As expected of a star! Your family must be 
thrilled! So, when are you going to see 
them? I'd love to get an exclusive 
interview with their touching reactions!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
No... My parents are back in my hometown, 
so—

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Oh, a phone call would be totally fine 
then! Let's see here... First off, could 
you tell me your family home's phone 
number...?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: P-Phone call? Umm, in that case... 0—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Even if this is an interview, prying 
for personal information is crossing the 
line. As someone affiliated with the 
academy, I can't let this slide.
choice_data_list:
Any further questions should go through 
the academy.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Huh, who are you? ...Gah, that badge! Ah, 
ahaha... You're from the academy! Excuse 
me then...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you for helping me. It seems he 
wasn't very well-mannered for a reporter 
after all.
choice_data_list:
If something seems suspicious, turn them 
down immediately.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: That's... true, but...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...To be honest, that reporter told me 
earlier that I'm a star Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
He said, "If you're a star, you have an 
obligation to answer questions. The fans 
want that too"...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
In that case, if I were to refuse to 
answer—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Wouldn't I be letting everyone down and 
betraying their expectations?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...From what she's saying, she really 
cares about her fans. Which means, all the 
more reason—
choice_data_list:
You really have to turn them down 
properly.

You really have to turn them down 
properly.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...However...
choice_data_list: Your fans want to protect you too.
Your fans want to protect you too.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...I see, that's true. Tome-san and 
Shige-san used to say that a lot, too.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Our Oguri-chan is our treasure." I should 
have been protecting that treasure, too...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I understand. From now on, I will 
turn them down.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Though, I wonder if I can turn them 
down properly.
choice_data_list: In that case, rely on the adults.
I'll teach you some magic words.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Then I'll be counting on you from now on.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The way you handled that just now was 
wonderful. And fortunately, you are 
affiliated with the academy.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...So it should be fine for me to rely on 
you, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...That was a remarkably frank response, 
but she makes a completely fair point. 
However—
choice_data_list: You really are a bit too honest sometimes.
You really are a bit too honest sometimes.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, seems so. My mother used to praise 
me for that, too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, I caught sight of Oguri Cap 
frankly asking questions to the adults 
around the academy.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Magic words?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: That's... what you just said earlier...?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I see. Once that reporter heard that, he 
ran away immediately. Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just then, a woman came running over to 
us.

text_block_list.name: Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
Oh, there you are! Oguri-san! I wanted to 
talk to you about the plushies—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: For that question, go through the academy!

text_block_list.name: Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Wait, what?! We were supposed to have 
a meeting about making the plushies 
today... right?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ah. I did hear about that... I... I'm 
sorry.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It looks like she'll need a bit more 
practice to master those magic words...
